dict.string: Total Factor uses your camera to scan food barcodes, read Nutrition Facts labels, and snap meal photos for AI nutrition analysis.
Total Factor reads smart-scale weight, lean body mass, body fat, waist, steps, sleep, and display-only active energy so your dashboard and weight trend stay effortlessly in sync.
Total Factor saves logged foods (calories, macros, micronutrients), manual weigh-ins, and completed strength workouts to Apple Health.
Total Factor uses your microphone for hands-free voice meal dictation when logging food.
Total Factor uses selected photos for Nutrition Facts label OCR, meal photo logging, and pose-matched progress photo comparisons.
Total Factor uses speech recognition to transcribe spoken meals into individual foods and gram portions.
